IPL Player Abishek Porel Arrested on Rape Allegations

Delhi Capitals cricketer Abishek Porel was arrested and denied bail following a complaint by a woman alleging rape. The woman claims Porel had a physical relationship with her under the false promise of marriage. Additional allegations include forced confinement and recording private moments. Bengal police took Porel into custody.
